A per-request backward slice from login() to the HTTP entry point will NOT contain the OTP check in any of these. (7) AUTHENTICATION-HISTORY CARRIERS that make a later mint skip a factor: allauth session['account_authentication_methods'] (flows/login.py:49-58) and mfa trust cookie (trust.py:63-80); two-factor remember-device cookie (utils.py:223-276); allauth passwordless record (webauthn flows.py:107); hijack session['hijack_history'] (views.py:94-103, 130-139); SimpleJWT claim copying refresh->access (tokens.py:393-411). External MFA/SSO evidence is NOT verified in code by social-core OIDC (acr_values only requested, open_id_connect.py:322-329), mozilla-django-oidc (verify_claims checks only email), DOT/allauth-idp (no amr/acr emitted; DOT auth_time = last_login, oauth2_validators.py:1383). (8) NON-HTTP / OUT-OF-SCOPE mints to report as excluded rather than drop: django.test.Client.login/force_login (test/client.py:829-901), DRF drf_create_token management command, Django admin token rows. METHOD & LIMITS: (a) An AST name-scan (parse-only) over all 18 unpacked packages found 179 call sites matching 28 mint-related names with 0 parse failures; most hits for generic names were false positives (e.g. 31 get_query_string hits in django/contrib/admin, template create_token, smtp login), and it could not distinguish social_core's login-parameter call from a real auth login -- evidence that a plain name list is both noisy and incomplete. (b) python-fido2 (used by allauth WebAuthn) and pyotp were not downloaded; statements about their behaviour are ASSUMED. (c) Only latest releases were read; behaviour differs by version (e.g. djoser's webauthn module targets py_webauthn<1.0). (d) No invitation-token implementation exists in any listed package (django-invitations was not in scope); the closest are signup/activation tokens (djoser email.py, allauth email confirmation).
